opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000; in special cases up to £750,000; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not open to individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by schools or FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students, or projects where the main purpose is to support a PhD. Overseas organisations only in exceptional cases with strong UK-focused dissemination plans.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (spring and autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year in autumn.

opportunities.title: Strategic Fund

amount.raw: Up to £15 million available; major grants typically in the range of £1-3 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations; not open to individuals without formal employment/relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by undergraduates or master's students, or PhD fees.
opportunities.summary: Major grants for new, transformative ideas capable of anticipating and addressing the most significant themes and developments shaping the UK public policy agenda, responding to one or more of the five priority questions. Currently closed; next round likely to open in the first half of 2027.
